risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (seller says Suzuki, but the photo doesn’t show any identifying badge/model).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the tank/logo and the engine/side cover showing the brand/model, plus a close-up of the VIN/engine number plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used motorcycle with no verified brand/model and no verified condition.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition not proven (starts, idles, gears, brakes).
risks.proof: Request a short video clip: cold start, 1st-to-5th gear shift demonstration, and a brake test (front + rear) showing stopping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven—assume worst case for buyer (needs inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Mileage/age not proven (seller claims bought new 6 months ago).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the odometer reading and the receipt/registration date (or warranty card).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/unknown mileage rather than “new 6 months ago.”

risks.risk: Rust/parts originality not confirmed (seller claims no rust and all parts original).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of: exhaust header, chain area, spokes/rims, engine casing, and any welds/repairs; plus a photo of any replacement parts labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible wear/repairs (no “no rust/original parts” benefit).

proof_requests: Clear front/side photos showing the Suzuki badge/logo and any model name (tank + side cover).
Close-up photo of engine number/VIN plate (for identity verification).
Video: cold start + gear shifting (1st to top gear) + front and rear brake test.
Photo of odometer reading and proof of purchase/registration date (receipt/warranty card).
Close-ups of exhaust header, chain area, rims/spokes, and engine casing to check rust and originality.
response.reason: The photo does not provide readable identity (brand/model) or proof of mechanical condition, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable.
